summary: Stop using episodic tags like 'भाग 1' or 'एपिसोड 1' on a brand-new channel with no established audience.
Avoid using specific obscure character names in titles (e.g., 'सावली देवी', 'राघव', 'माया') that cold viewers do not care about.
Focus titles on high-stakes emotional triggers: betrayal, financial deception, and family secrets.
Use first-person curiosity hooks ('मैंने सबको कहा...') which delivered the only organic view and full retention.
Keep standalone stories self-contained so new viewers don't feel like they missed prior context.
Aim for story lengths around 10 minutes (600+ seconds), as long-form dramatic pacing holds strong completion.
Align channel targeting and metadata strictly with Hindi family/emotional drama audiences.
